question: Should OpenClaw core accept this experimental Claw mission-control surface after the storage/security/proof blockers are repaired, or should the work be split or paused until a narrower sponsored product path exists?
rationale: The patch creates new core runtime, config, Gateway API, UI, docs, and workflow contracts; automation can identify blockers, but it cannot decide whether this product/API surface belongs in core at this size.

options.title: Pause or split until sponsored
options.body: Keep the PR open but require a maintainer-sponsored plan and narrower landing slices before any merge path resumes.

options.title: Sponsor the full Claw surface
options.body: Accept the product direction only after the branch is rebased and the storage, security, and proof blockers are repaired.

options.title: Close as too broad
options.body: Close this PR and ask for separate narrowly scoped PRs for browser/runtime hardening, Gateway API, UI, and docs.

recommendation.title: Pause or split until sponsored
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require a maintainer-sponsored plan and narrower landing slices before any merge path resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans product direction, core config/API policy, and the storage/security guardrails reflected in current repository policy and history.
